roadmap.walking_skeleton: SKIPPED — DWD-01: brownfield leaf-view extension; WrappedText+LayoutEngine integration path already validated by existing wrapped-text Slice 1-3 acceptance suites. No new walking skeleton warranted per DISTILL wave decision.

phases.name: Implement maxLines clipping in WrappedText and LayoutEngine

steps.name: Implement clippedLines prefix clipping on WrappedText
steps.description: Replace the scaffold stub in WrappedText.clippedLines so it returns wrappedLines clipped to the first maxLines entries using Array.prefix. When maxLines is nil the method returns all wrapped lines unchanged, preserving backward compatibility.
steps.criteria: clippedLines returns exactly maxLines strings when content wraps to more lines than maxLines; returns first maxLines strings in order (not later lines); returns all lines when maxLines is nil; returns an empty array when content is empty regardless of maxLines; returns an empty array when maxLines is 0; returns exactly one string when maxLines is 1 for multi-line content; is deterministic across repeated calls with identical inputs.
steps.scenario_name: clippedLines returns exactly maxLines strings when content wraps to more lines than maxLines

additional_test_files.scenario_name: clippedLines with maxLines zero returns empty array
additional_test_files.note: Slice 2 clippedLines edge cases: scenarios 7 (maxLines 0 empty), 8 (maxLines 1 multi-line), 9 (empty content maxLines 3) all covered by this step's criteria

steps.name: Extend layoutWrappedTextNode to apply maxLines floor and ceiling
steps.sizing_rationale: Step covers 14 scenarios (8 Slice 1 layout + 6 Slice 2 edge cases) which exceeds the 8-scenario threshold. However, all 14 scenarios test the same 2-3 line change in layoutWrappedTextNode (height formula + child prefix). Splitting into floor/ceiling sub-steps would be artificial since both invariants emerge from the same formula: Float(maxLines ?? allLines.count) * lineHeight. Accepted after review.
steps.description: Update LayoutEngine.layoutWrappedTextNode: derive allLines via wrappedLines (unchanged), compute displayLineCount = maxLines ?? allLines.count, clip children to prefix(maxLines ?? allLines.count), set height = Float(maxLines ?? allLines.count) * lineHeight. The root frame width remains constraints.maxWidth. The maxLines nil path is a strict no-op relative to pre-feature behavior.
steps.criteria: Short content with maxLines 3 reserves height of 3 * fontSize even when it wraps to fewer lines (floor). Long content with maxLines 3 produces exactly 3 child nodes and height of 3 * fontSize (ceiling). Content that exactly fills maxLines produces 3 child nodes and correct height without clipping. maxLines nil preserves existing content-height behaviour (regression). Layout height is stable across varying content lengths when maxLines is fixed. Child nodes are stacked at y-origins 0, fontSize, 2*fontSize when maxLines clips to 3. Root frame width equals constraints.maxWidth. maxLines 0 produces 0 children and height 0.0. maxLines 1 clips multi-line content to a single child with height equal to fontSize. Empty content with maxLines 3 reserves three-line height with 0 children (floor applies to empty). Unbreakable word wider than maxWidth with maxLines 1 produces 1 child safely without crash.
steps.scenario_name: short narration with maxLines 3 reserves three-line height even though content wraps to one line

additional_test_files.scenario_name: maxLines zero produces zero children and zero height
additional_test_files.note: All 6 layout edge cases in Slice 2 are covered by this step's criteria

files_to_modify.change: Replace the __SCAFFOLD__ body of clippedLines with: return Array(wrappedLines(measurer: measurer, maxWidth: maxWidth).prefix(maxLines ?? Int.max))

In layoutWrappedTextNode: derive allLines via wrappedLines, compute displayLineCount = maxLines ?? allLines.count, use prefix(displayLineCount) for childNodes, set height = Float(displayLineCount) * lineHeight
